description:
This protocol is a modified version of this sample aliquoting protocol.

With this version of the protocol, the user can specify the number of plates they would like to fill (up to 6). When run, the robot will transfer the specified volume two times (2x) to each tube, in each tube rack, and change tip after each liquid transfer.

Please note that this protocol uses a custom labware definition for the tube rack (definition included with download). For more information regarding custom labware definition usage on the OT-2, please see this article: Using labware in your protocols.


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.17.0 or later)
NEST 1 Well Reservoir 195 mL
Opentrons P1000 GEN2 single-channel electronic pipette
Opentrons 96 Tip Rack 1000 µL
24-Tube Tube Rack plus Tubes



Tube Racks
Load sequentially deck slots, in this order: 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9

Tip Racks
One tip rack is needed for every two tube racks. The tip racks should be loaded in deck slots: 1, 4

Reagent Reservoirs
One reagent reservoir should be used for every three tube racks. The reservoirs should be loaded in deck slots: 11 (will be used first), 10
